prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a pair of hands carefully cutting along the edge of a white paper template placed on a textured, dark leather surface. The left hand holds the template steady, while the right hand wields a sharp utility knife, its blade glinting in the soft, directional light. The focus is shallow, drawing attention to the precision of the action and the tactile details of the leather and paper, while the background fades into a gentle blur. The color palette is muted and sophisticated, dominated by deep blacks, soft grays, and subtle highlights, evoking a sense of craftsmanship and meticulous attention to detail. The lighting is moody and dramatic, with strong contrasts and a hint of natural daylight, emphasizing the textures and contours of the materials and hands. The overall style is realistic and intimate, reminiscent of a high-end artisan workshop or a behind-the-scenes look at bespoke manufacturing, with a sense of quiet concentration and skilled manual labor.
